gloss: to let wither; to kill (a plant)

forms.label: ている past polite
forms.negative: {枯|か}らしていませんでした

definitions.gloss: to let wither; to cause to dry up; to kill (a plant)
definitions.explanation: To cause a plant to wilt and die, typically through neglect (not watering) or by using chemicals. The transitive counterpart of 枯れる (to wither).

examples.japanese: ⟦{水|みず}→水：02258_mizu⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦やらなくて→やる：02980_yaru⟧⟦{花|はな}→花：00523_hana⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{枯|か}らしてしまった。
examples.english: I let the flowers die because I didn't water them.

examples.japanese: ⟦{除草剤|じょそうざい}→除草剤：24124_josouzai⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{雑草|ざっそう}→雑草：04996_zassou⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{枯|か}らす。
examples.english: I kill the weeds with herbicide.

examples.japanese: ⟦{旅行中|りょこうちゅう}→旅行中：28581_ryokouchuu⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{留守|るす}→留守：01754_rusu⟧にして⟦いたら→いる：00495_iru⟧、⟦{観葉植物|かんようしょくぶつ}→観葉植物：19239_kanyoushokubutsu⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{全部|ぜんぶ}→全部：02888_zenbu⟧{枯|か}らしてしまった。
examples.english: I was away on a trip, and I ended up killing all my houseplants.

notes:
COMMON PATTERNS:
Godan verb ({五段動詞|ごだんどうし}), transitive. The intransitive pair is ⟦{枯|か}れる→枯れる：04589_kareru⟧ (to wither; to die — of plants).

USAGE:
Often used with ～てしまう to express regret about accidentally killing a plant. Also used deliberately when talking about removing unwanted plants.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{花|はな}→花：00523_hana⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{枯|か}らす (to let flowers die)
- ⟦{木|き}→木：00524_ki⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{枯|か}らす (to kill a tree)
- ⟦{雑草|ざっそう}→雑草：04996_zassou⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{枯|か}らす (to kill weeds)
- ⟦{喉|のど}→喉：00977_nodo⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{枯|か}らす (to make one's throat hoarse — from shouting)
